name: Live Intently
tagline: Build mindful habits, live with intention
longDescription: Live Intently is a comprehensive habit tracking and personal growth application designed to help you build mindful habits and live each day with purpose. Track your daily habits, set morning intentions, and monitor your progress over time with beautiful visualizations.
shortDescription: A cross-platform habit tracking and personal growth app with daily intentions, progress visualization, and seamless synchronization across all your devices.

features.title: Habit Tracking
features.description: Track unlimited habits with customizable frequencies and reminders

features.title: Daily Intentions
features.description: Set and review your morning intentions to start each day mindfully

features.title: Cross-Platform Sync
features.description: Seamless synchronization across Android, iOS, and Chrome extension

features.title: Progress Analytics
features.description: Beautiful charts and statistics to visualize your growth journey

features.title: Smart Reminders
features.description: Intelligent notifications that adapt to your schedule and habits

features.title: Dark Mode
features.description: Easy on the eyes with full dark mode support across all platforms
